entities.summary: Fedir Kyrylovych Hlukh was a Soviet Ukrainian lawyer and statesman. He served as Minister of Justice of the Ukrainian SSR (1953–1957), Chairman of the Supreme Court of the Ukrainian SSR (1957–1963), and Prosecutor of the Ukrainian SSR (1963–1983). He was a Deputy of the Supreme Soviet of the Ukrainian SSR. From 1960 to 1966, he was a member of the Auditing Commission of the Communist Party of Ukraine, from 1966 to 1976 he was a candidate member of the Central Committee, and from 1976 to 1984 he was a Member of the Central Committee of the CPU.
